top_signals.title: Australian Unemployment Climbs to 4.6% Even as Jobs Gain
top_signals.summary: Australian unemployment climbed further in August as more people sought work, overshadowing a jump in hiring just days before the Reserve Bank meets to weigh resuming interest-rate increases.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Tumbling Global Government Bonds Put Yields on Brink of 4%
top_signals.summary: A worsening bond selloff is pushing the average yield on global government debt to within a whisker of 4%, a level not seen since 2007.
